android.desc:
Stream movies & TV series on Fandango –  including free entertainment, new releases, and fan favorites – with no subscription required. Rent or buy the latest releases, build your digital library, and watch across your favorite devices.

* Stream for free: Enjoy thousands of free movies & series with limited commercials.
* Rent or buy: Watch new releases and classics anytime on Fandango.
* Build your library: Grow and access your eligible collection across participating platforms.
* Watch anywhere: Stream on your favorite devices or download eligible purchases for offline viewing.
* Bundle & save: Access personalized offers, bundles, and exclusive deals.
* Premium formats: Enjoy high-quality streaming with premium picture and sound formats where available.
* Safer viewing: Use kids mode with Common Sense Media ratings, reviews, and parental controls.
* Discover more: Explore curated collections, Rotten Tomatoes scores, trailers, and entertainment recommendations.

Part of the Fandango experience: Discover movies in theaters, get tickets, and connect your FanClub account where available.

By downloading, installing, and using this app, you agree to Fandango’s Privacy Policy (https://www.versantprivacy.com/privacy) and Terms and Policies (https://www.fandango.com/policies/terms-and-policies).

quotes.text:
I think you're confusing Google with Apple. The Play Store's policies are much more reasonable, and allow third party payment processors for purchasing digital items that can be consumed outside of the app itself. In fact, here's a third party video store on the Play Store [1], and here's Amazon's own Prime Music app [2].

[1] https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=air.com.vudu.air.DownloaderTablet
[2] https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.amazon.mp3
quotes.story_title: Amazon Will Ban Sale of Apple, Google Video-Streaming Devices
